# netbox_device_interface (Data Source)

Retrieves a single device interface from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_interface" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  device_id = 1
}

output "device_interface_id" {
  value = data.netbox_device_interface.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the device interface.

### Optional

- `cable_id` (Number) The ID of the cable associated with the device interface.
- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device associated with the device interface.
- `module_id` (Number) The ID of the module associated with the device interface.
